name: Final Integrated
scope: Current NeuroCore trunk; legacy history remains outside active current path
integrated_mechanisms: causal online plasticity with per-sample modulation
gradient arbitration and optimizer-update alignment audit
negative_findings: HiPPO preserves directional recall but amplitude decays strongly at long horizons and collapses by delay 256 in the current probe.
Hybrid HiPPO+cascade is not superior to pure HiPPO on the current delayed probe.
Event-bank requires explicit credit/routing key; without it, memory separation cannot infer causal assignment.
Synergy feedback shows short-run gains but is not yet proven on long-horizon delayed tasks.
Optimizer post-update alignment reduces measured update conflict but requires further optimizer-state-consistency study before default promotion.
Learned initial state did not improve matched-seed quality sufficiently to justify default promotion.
Sparse product-key memory improves address selectivity in isolated probes but short full-trunk training is not yet better than dense memory.
next_frontier: V120 — Long-Horizon Causal Qualification + memory/credit ablation + optimizer-state-safe alignment + mobile resource qualification
